source.description: Finished film of one governed OpenAdapt run against a real local OpenEMR instance loaded with synthetic data. Disclosures are burned into the frames. The centerpiece (0:54-1:06) is the fail-safe halt on a duplicate-chart identity ambiguity: the identity check reports 0 of 1 confirmed and the run writes nothing.
